summary: Phase 7 Testing Complete - All 5 requested features verified working. Reference designs API returns 8 designs from Supabase database, Blog categories API returns 5 categories from database, Admin Products form shows gallery upload section for both Digital Downloads and Pet Care collections.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Schema changes verified working. Reference designs and blog categories now return data from Supabase database. Gallery upload UI is correctly implemented for Digital Downloads (blue themed) and Pet Care (green themed) collections.

reference_designs_api_from_db.details: GET /api/reference-designs returns 8 designs from Supabase database: Royal Portrait ($15), Watercolor Dream ($10), Pop Art Style ($12), Minimalist Line ($8), Oil Masterpiece ($18), Neon Glow ($14), Pencil Sketch ($10), Cartoon Fun ($12). All have active=true and proper sort_order.

blog_categories_api_from_db.details: GET /api/blog/categories returns 5 categories from Supabase database: Home Decor, Pet Care, Pet Health, Photography, Training. Each has proper id, name, slug, description fields.

admin_gallery_upload_digital_downloads.details: When Digital Downloads collection is selected in Add Product form, a blue-themed 'Product Gallery Images' section appears with '+Add' button. Text: 'Add multiple images to showcase your digital product from different angles'. Also shows File Format, File Size, Downloadable File upload, Free Download checkbox.

admin_gallery_upload_pet_care.details: When Pet Care collection is selected in Add Product form, a green-themed 'Product Gallery Images' section appears with '+Add' button. Text: 'Add multiple images to showcase your pet care product'. Also shows Ingredients, Weight/Size fields, and Dropshipping (CJ Dropshipping) section with Supplier SKU, Supplier Name, Supplier URL.

gallery_upload_multiple_images.details: Gallery section uses form.gallery_urls array. Upload handler (handleGalleryUpload) appends new images to existing array. removeGalleryImage removes by index. Each uploaded image shows thumbnail preview with delete button on hover.

screenshots: .screenshots/12_petcare_modal_correct.png - Pet Care with gallery and dropshipping sections
